in_sanskrit.name: Dola
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Spinner, Dancer
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dola एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Dola is the name of a divine female figure, often depicted as a spinner or dancer. She is also associated with the goddess Durga and represents the cyclical nature of time and the universe.
